title: Solid 2.0 Effects + Async Explanation
description: Explains why Solid 2.0 split effects into compute and apply phases and how async readiness flows through scheduling and boundaries.

items.body: The old single callback mixed dependency discovery with side effects. Splitting compute from apply lets the runtime discover dependencies and pending async before user effects run.

steps.body: The compute phase reads reactive sources and returns the value that the later side-effect phase will consume.
The apply phase runs after compute work has settled, so async readiness can be coordinated before side effects touch the outside world.
